description: Skald engine health: the request path, dispatch, the store and the workflows themselves. Panel descriptions say what a number means, not what it is.

panels.title: skaldd
panels.description: 1 when Prometheus can scrape the engine. Skald is single-node: this is the whole deployment.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: not_found excluded: polling for a workflow that has not started yet is a normal shape.

panels.title: p99 append
panels.description: Every durable operation goes through this path. Above 500ms, ticket; above 2s, page.

panels.title: Sync match ratio
panels.description: The single best dispatch health signal. A healthy fleet has more pollers than tasks, so nearly every match is sync.

panels.title: Unserved queues
panels.description: Queues with work and no poller. Anything above zero is the SkaldQueueUnserved page.

targets.expr: count(skald_task_queue_backlog > 0 and on (namespace, task_queue, kind) skald_task_queue_pollers == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Errors by code
panels.description: code is the protocol code, not an HTTP status.

panels.title: Long-poll duration
panels.description: Piled up at the poll timeout means no work is arriving; left-shifted means the queue is hot. Neither is a fault.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: A parked long poll is in flight by design: a healthy worker fleet holds one per poller.

panels.title: Task queue backlog
panels.description: Task references waiting for a poller. The cap is 50,000 per queue; past that they are dropped and recovered by the startup scan.

panels.title: Dropped tasks and poll timeouts
panels.description: A dropped task is delayed, not lost. Poll timeouts are expected and healthy when workers outnumber tasks.

panels.title: History append duration
panels.description: Measured at the API boundary, so it includes decode, validation and state rebuild.

panels.title: Retry amplification
panels.description: Retries increment attempts, so a value meaningfully above 1 is your retry amplification. Above 3 sustained means a dependency is failing and you are hammering it.

panels.title: Busiest activity types
panels.description: skald_activity_results_total is not labelled by activity type, so this is attempts only. Use the logs to find which activity is failing.

panels.title: Goroutines and threads
panels.description: One goroutine per parked poll is normal. A monotonic climb is a leak.
